title: 一场盼望已久的宴会 · A Long-expected Party
prompt_zh: 袋底洞的比尔博·巴金斯先生宣布，他不久将举办一场格外盛大的宴会，庆祝自己的一百一十一岁生日；霍比屯顿时议论纷纷，一片欢腾。
prompt_en: When Mr. Bilbo Baggins of Bag End announced that he would shortly be celebrating his eleventy-first birthday with a party of special magnificence, there was much talk and excitement in Hobbiton.
source: J. R. R. Tolkien, The Fellowship of the Ring — opening paragraph
note: Stills generated from the repo prompt; motion is cinematic Ken Burns (Imagine video API blocked on this workspace: ZDR requires upload_url).

shots.caption_zh: 袋底洞的比尔博·巴金斯先生宣布，他不久将庆祝自己的一百一十一岁生日……
shots.caption_en: When Mr. Bilbo Baggins of Bag End announced that he would shortly be celebrating his eleventy-first birthday…

shots.caption_zh: 场地里支起帐篷和长桌，靠着那棵大树。
shots.caption_en: Tents and tables were raised in the field by the great tree.

shots.caption_zh: 霍比屯顿时议论纷纷，一片欢腾。
shots.caption_en: …and there was much talk and excitement in Hobbiton.

shots.caption_zh: 暮色降临，灯笼一盏盏亮起来。
shots.caption_en: Lanterns were lit one by one as evening fell.

shots.caption_zh: 随后，山丘上方的天空绽放开来。
shots.caption_en: Then the sky above the Hill began to bloom.

shots.caption_zh: 这场宴会，霍比屯会记得很久。
shots.caption_en: It was a party long remembered in Hobbiton.
